title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Fantasy Springs Resort Casino, Indio | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Fantasy Springs Resort Casino in Indio, California, USA, on 25 June 2006.

It was the eighth show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr returned to the Fantasy Springs Resort Casino on 1 August 2008 and 12 November 2016.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion

  • It Don’t Come Easy

  • ‘Honey Don’t’
  • ‘Everybody Wants You’ (Billy Squier)
